theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_sa_ml_compact_support_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) r → ∫⁻ x, ‖convolution ρ h (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - h x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
